name: Costume☆Paradise ~Cinderella Rhapsody~
original_name: こすちゅうむ☆パラダイス ～シンデレラ狂想曲～
source:
A huge entertainment theme park "Cinderella" is build on an island in Tokyo Bay aimed to "fulfill all people's dreams". Hero is a medical college student who works here as a part-time employee. The hourly is sky high, but he is required to cosplay along with the girls. He overcomes  embarrassment and starts to pay attention to the cute girls around him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座名为“灰姑娘”的大型娱乐主题公园建在东京湾的一座岛上，旨在“实现所有人的梦想”。主人公是一名医学生，作为兼职员工在这里工作。时薪很高，但他被要求和女孩们一起cosplay。他克服了尴尬，开始注意身边可爱的女孩们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
